text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 蓝绿色钩针三角比基尼配同色系带泳裤和短裹裙，米白钩针饰边及贝壳流苏。配饰：贝壳多层项链；贝壳细腰链；金色宽手镯；细串珠手链。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create an unoccupied retail product flat lay on pure white, portrait 2:3. A teal crochet swimwear set: triangle halter swim top, tie-side swim bottoms and short crochet wrap skirt, cream edging and small shell tassels. Beside the garments, individually spaced: layered shell necklace, thin shell waist chain, wide gold cuff bracelet, delicate bead bracelet. Realistic textile and jewelry product photography. Only unworn products, no person or body, no mannequin, no text, no setting, no footwear.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
